summary: Owner chose LLM-assisted relevance judging. Split the budget model into a runtime provider (DeepSeek, unchanged, verifiable prices) and an evaluation-only annotator (taomu relay / gpt-6-astra) so the judge differs from the ranking model (ADR 0004). judge_relevance moves to a token-only evaluation section that charges a measured ~4,403-token hidden prefix; runtime ceilings/scenarios are unaffected. Two live non-private probes recorded. No product measurement or gate passed.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit d0cb778 (planning baseline v2). Registry/docs/budget-model changes plus two provider probes; no app runtime.

budget_impact.rationale: No app runtime exists and no gate changed. The runtime provider/prices/ceilings are unchanged; a separate evaluation section was added with price_verifiable=false and a measured hidden prefix, and budget.py now refuses to treat annotator prices as verifiable. Probes were one tiny call each, not billed runtime or a measurement.
budget_impact.before: judge_relevance was a runtime operation under DeepSeek with a 9k input cap; no separate evaluation budget; one DeepSeek probe.
budget_impact.after: runtime ops = daily_triage/llm_rerank/weekly_digest/paper_qa/selection_translate/query_expand on DeepSeek; evaluation section holds judge_relevance for taomu with 9k cap + 4,403 hidden prefix per call (149,030 token cap for a 200-item batch, USD unverified); LABEL-01/R-EVAL-LABEL/E-LLM-LABEL-VALIDITY added.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: Expected block: implementation approval missing, gateway/tokenizer not implemented, all blocking gates not_run

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; registry/doc/budget-model consistency only, not product quality or billing

open_risks: taomu pricing unverifiable and model identity self-reported; hidden ~4.4k-token prefix per call may vary and cannot be audited.
Evaluation labels are an unvalidated proxy until E-LLM-LABEL-VALIDITY passes; an all-LLM evaluation is exploratory only.
LABEL-01 blocked until DATA-01 freezes a candidate set; seeds still unresolved.
Both API keys were shared in chat and only stored in .local (gitignored); rotate them.
